c.gift.title: Gift estimator (cultural guide)
c.gift.guide: A private per-planner suggestion from a few questions. No data is shared; no guest sees another's amount; free forever (C-11).
c.promo.title: Promotion pack (export only)
c.promo.export_only: Nothing is posted and nothing is spent automatically (C-12).
d.title: Itinerary (time zones)
d.utc_hint: Times are stored in UTC and displayed in Europe/Bucharest and the trip zone (INF8).
d.settlement: Settlement per currency (from the one ledger)
e.title: Rehearsal and event-day operation
e.rehearse.title: Rehearsal simulation (read-only)
e.rehearse.hint: Steps through the day as recorded; conflicts are flagged, nothing is saved.
e.checkin.title: QR check-in
e.checkin.hint: Scan the QR on the printed invitation (C-09); arrival is marked via an audited correction (principle 4).
e.flow.title: Guest-flow estimate (aggregates only, Q5)
e.offline.title: Offline capture (sync queue)
e.offline.hint: Arrivals and own checklist ticks only, reconciled once on reconnect (Q4); conflicts are surfaced, never silently merged.
e.sus.title: Sustainability goals (optional)
e.sus.hint: Goals tracked against measured quantities; unknown stays unknown (principle 5).
lau.notice.title: Cookie notice
lau.report.title: Report content or a listing
lau.report.hint: Notice-and-action mechanism (DSA): anyone can report illegal content or an unlawful listing; every report is logged and decided, and the reason is given to the affected party.
lau.report.rules: illegal listings and content in Romania/EU are removed; the decision and reason are kept in the audit log; you can contest a decision by replying to the notice.
lau.report.thanks: Reports are rate-limited per IP; thank you for flagging this.
lau.item.1: LAU1 — Legal documents (Terms, Privacy, cookie notice) linked before the first account; cookie notice shown once in-app, re-shown only when the cookie set changes (implemented). Owner: PrivacyOwner.
lau.item.2: LAU2 — ANSPDCP formalities + DPIA for discovery, household data and MCP transfer (operator). Owner: PrivacyOwner.
lau.item.3: LAU3 — Email domain warm-up (SPF/DKIM/DMARC + seed sends) before the first sign-in email (operator). Owner: SecurityAdministrator.
lau.item.4: LAU4 — External penetration test before the first guest link (operator). Owner: SecurityAdministrator.
lau.item.5: LAU5 — Monitoring, alerts, RTO 4h/RPO 24h and an incident log in the console; plain-language messages on guest pages (implemented: /console/incidents + banner). Owner: SecurityAdministrator.
lau.item.6: LAU6 — Business terms before the first business registers, quoting the Featured rules (operator). Owner: CommercialManager.
lau.item.7: LAU7 — Launch-day runbook with the two-person rule (operator; solo launch is out of scope by design). Owner: PlatformAdmin.
lau.item.8: LAU8 — DSA: ANCOM registration, point of contact, notice-and-action (implemented: /report + moderation console), annual reporting (operator). Owner: PlatformAdmin.
lau.item.9: LAU9 — Accessibility statement ro+en (public site), WCAG 2.2 AA, feedback route, date and method recorded in the console (implemented: /console/launch). Owner: PrivacyOwner.
console.incidents.field.title: Incident title
console.launch.desc: LAU1–LAU9 checklist: items implemented in code are marked; operator-owned gates must be completed by the operator.
console.launch.a11y.title: Accessibility statement (LAU9)
site.hero.lead: Plan weddings, baptisms, trips and any occasion in one place: invitations with personal links, RSVP, programme, budget, suppliers and event day. Free at launch.
site.hero.f1: Invitations with personal links and RSVP — each household sees only its own data.
site.hero.f2: Day-of programme, QR check-in and offline capture when the network drops.
site.hero.f3: Budget and per-currency settlement from one ledger; nothing is ever paid automatically.
